description: Re-run the infrastructure setup on one of your resource pools, as the portal's 'Update infrastructure' button does: it brings a pool whose infra_update_available is true to the current infrastructure, and runs again on a pool whose last run failed (status 'error', its last_error naming the step that failed). It converges the box over SSH with the key you authorised; your data and running apps are untouched. It runs as a job: poll get_job_status with the returned job_id until it is completed or failed (up to 20 minutes); list_clusters then shows the pool 'connected'. A pool never provisioned is refused: provision it in the portal. Resource pools are part of the Managed server plan. One operation runs on a pool at a time: while another runs, the call is refused and the refusal names the running job. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: reprovision_cluster
title: Re-run Resource Pool Infrastructure
